lines.t: (Intro – spoken over hard 808s)
Yo… check the prophecy…
Everlasting stepped down…
Immanu El in the flesh…
(Verse 1)
Behold the Everlasting dropped from the throne,
God in the flesh, YahuShua alone,
Express image of the Holy, face of the unseen,
Through Him every atom got made and still lean.
He hold the whole universe, atoms don’t drift,
By Him all things consist, ain’t no other gift.
He gon’ strike that great image, smash it to dust,
Break every nation, leave empires in rust.
He the Kingdom, the Power, the Glory full stop,
No debate, no rival, He lock the whole block.
Woe to the people still sleepin’ on earth,
Holy One comin’ to collect what He’s worth.
(Chorus)
He shall pour out till the wrath is complete,
Roar in the battle, make the whole planet heat.
Earth start tremblin’, heavin’ at His face,
Collapse under vesture, break under the pace.
Islands flee, mountains crumble at the swipe,
Footsteps of the Lord make the dirt start to hype.
Every knee gon’ drop, every tongue confess,
King of Hosts only — ain’t no other address.
(Verse 2)
Behold the power in the right hand of God,
Tremble in fear, shed tears on the sod.
Son of Man feet gon’ stomp heavy and slow,
Tread on the mighty, make the great ones bow low.
Slain of the Lord stretch ten-thousand deep,
Cut by the sword from the mouth that don’t sleep.
Great and mighty nations get walked like a rug,
Judgment ain’t soft, ain’t no second hug.
Fear the Lord now, humble in the sight,
King in the building, dark turn into light.
No more pride left when the footsteps arrive,
Whole earth confess while the remnant survive.
(Chorus)
He shall pour out till the wrath is complete,
Roar in the battle, make the whole planet heat.
Earth start tremblin’, heavin’ at His face,
Collapse under vesture, break under the pace.
Islands flee, mountains crumble at the swipe,
Footsteps of the Lord make the dirt start to hype.
Every knee gon’ drop, every tongue confess,
King of Hosts only — ain’t no other address.
(Outro – fading ad-libs)
YahuShua…
Immanu El…
Right hand power…
Tremble…
Confess the King…
Only Lord of Hosts…
